1.consolidated_definition: Que se somete a alguien o algo que percibe como de mayor fuerza, sin cuestionar su autoridad. Usualmente despectivo. Un gobierno del partido anexionista, un gobierno completamente arrodillado ante los intereses de Estados Unidos y de la Junta de Control Fiscal, que es el organismo designado por el Congreso y que tiene control absoluto sobre lo que está pasando en Puerto Rico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Submits to someone or something perceived as being of greater force without questioning their authority, often in a derogatory manner. Typically refers to an annexationist government, a completely subservient government that bows down to the interests of the United States and the Fiscal Control Board, which is an agency designated by Congress with absolute control over what is happening in Puerto Rico.
